_comment: QID -> canonical display name overrides for the Screen pipeline. build_scores.py consults this in nm() BEFORE falling back to people.json or the raw QID, so a person whose Wikidata english label never resolved still shows a real name. A hard guard in build_scores.py warns on any bare QID that survives; export_screen.py drops any that still slip through. Add new entries here whenever the guard fires. Seeded 2026-07-25.
